messages:
Sam: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we tracked the bursts to an oscillating route set at the edge that triggered cross-region failovers and repeated TLS handshakes. Short version: stale SNI->backend mismatch + healthcheck timing mismatch = cascading retries for ~3% of flows.
Priya: Oof. Do we have a minimal repro or sample logs?
Sam: pasted a small sample below (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-12T03:12:11Z] ingress: client=10.4.5.6 sni=api.customer.example TLS_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT backend=grn-edge-3 region=eu-west-1 fallback=us-east-1
[2026-03-12T03:12:12Z] lb: route-set-change applied old=grn-edge-3 new=grn-edge-5
[2026-03-12T03:12:13Z] backend: connection-reuse-failed id=abcd health=unknown
```
Sam: The key signal was the route-set-change happening right as the connection reused SNI entries. That caused the backend to reject and the LB to fall back across regions.
Josh: Do we know which autoscaling/route propagation window is at fault? Could be the 5s debounce we added last year.
Olga: I looked at the routing service rollout; propagation to edge caches is ~6-12s in worst-case. Combined with healthcheck probe intervals we can get into a gap.
maria_prod: Suggestion: immediate mitigation = increase probe grace and add an in-flight SNI eviction on route flips. Longer term = make route propagations atomic w.r.t SNI mappings.
Priya: Agree. Can someone own the short-term mitigation? I can do the probe tweak ticket but need an owner for the SNI eviction change.
Sam: I'll own the SNI eviction change (net-runtime). ETA EOD tomorrow to draft a patch.
Priya: I'll open the probe-grace PR and add a canary rollout to eu-west-1 first. ETA today lunchtime.
Josh: I'll add a metric and dashboard for "sni_evictions", "cross_region_fallbacks", and a 1m/5m rate alert. Can we make the alert page to on-call after 1m spike > 10/min?
Olga: I'll coordinate with infra to reduce our route propagation jitter; filing infra ticket for propagation batching. ETA Fri COB.
Sam: Action items recap:
- Sam: implement in-flight SNI eviction + unit tests (ETA: 2026-03-25 EOD)
- Priya: probe-grace PR and canary rollout (ETA: 2026-03-23 lunch)
- Josh: dashboards + alert (ETA: 2026-03-24 AM)
- Olga: infra batching ticket for route propagation (ETA: 2026-03-27 COB)
- maria_prod: coordinate QA canary and customer comms template (ETA: 2026-03-24)

Sam: small ops note — before deploying eviction we should patch two backends with `--sni-allowlist` toggle off to avoid mass rejects; will add rollout steps to PR.
eng-deploy-bot: deploy/redwood-net-runtime/patch-2026-03-23 succeeded in eu-west-1 (canary) :white_check_mark:
Priya: can everyone ack the timelines here? If no objections I'll triage and attach these to the postmortem doc.
Josh: ack. I'll start dashboard skeleton now.
Olga: ack.
maria_prod: ack — I'll prep the comms and test plan.
Sam: thanks all. I'll post a short `howto` in #eng-runtime once PR is up. If anyone spots recurring patterns tied to other SNI flips, ping me and we'll fold into this set of actions. :thumbsup:
